Type: implementation or qualification task
Plan: docs/institutional-pilot-epics.md
Assessment: docs/institutional-readiness-plan.md
Work key: W02.4
Accountable role (person unassigned): Frontend/integration engineer with curator
Pilot scope: required

Scope: Make quality and provenance visible without expanding numerical analysis.
Work kind: engineering
Acceptance gate: W02 (bd-01M4W40KPVEFQSMWFEDZZC69SW)

Acceptance criteria:
1. Display existing assessment findings and authorized report/result metadata with exact input/output release and tool evidence where available.
2. Record human review separately from automated checks; a new release visibly leaves the old review historical and requires an explicit new review.
3. Protect report links and review notes with current authority; no success badge implies full BIDS conformance or scientific quality beyond the recorded evidence.

Verification: Old/new release review tests, report access/withdrawal tests and curator walkthrough of findings versus human judgment.
Expected evidence: docs/evidence/institutional-pilot/W02.4/receipt.json
Evidence must include: exact source/artifact and configuration identity; commands or human procedure and observed outcomes; fixtures/data scope and environment; acceptance-criterion results, negative cases and limitations; reviewer/acceptance evidence when the task requires institutional input.

Starting code/evidence:
- docs/vision.md
- modules/http/src/main/resources/sanctity/ui/app.js

Blocked by:
- W02.3: bd-01M4W5PBDY3VQDSFZHPKG1FV35

Completion rule: satisfy every acceptance criterion with observed evidence. Failed or not-run requirements stay open. Preserve scientific identity/history and current authority; create blocking remediation work for discovered scope. Automated or simulated evidence cannot replace a required institutional or human result. No implementation is claimed by this plan.
